sections.title: PawSharp.Interactivity.Extensions.MessageExtensions
sections.content:
PawSharp.Interactivity.Extensions.MessageExtensions

Methods

WaitForReactionAsync(Message message, DiscordClient client, User user, string emoji, Nullable<TimeSpan> timeout)

Waits for a reaction on the message.

ParameterDescription
messageThe message to wait for reactions on.
clientThe Discord client.
userThe user whose reaction to wait for.
emojiThe specific emoji to wait for, or null for any emoji.
timeoutThe timeout for waiting.

Returns: The interactivity result.

CollectReactionsAsync(Message message, DiscordClient client, Nullable<TimeSpan> timeout)

Collects reactions on the message.

ParameterDescription
messageThe message to collect reactions from.
clientThe Discord client.
timeoutThe timeout for collecting.

Returns: The collected reactions.

CreatePollAsync(Message message, DiscordClient client, string question, IEnumerable<string> options, Nullable<TimeSpan> timeout)

Creates a poll on the message.

ParameterDescription
messageThe message to create a poll on.
clientThe Discord client.
questionThe poll question.
optionsThe poll options.
timeoutThe timeout for the poll.

Returns: A task representing the asynchronous operation.

WaitForButtonAsync(Message message, DiscordClient client, User user, string customId, Nullable<TimeSpan> timeout)

Waits for a button click on this message and returns the resulting interaction.

ParameterDescription
messageThe message whose buttons to listen on.
clientThe Discord client.
userThe user whose interaction to accept, or to accept any user.
customIdThe custom_id of the specific button to wait for, or to accept any button on the message.
timeoutThe maximum time to wait. Falls back to if not specified.

Returns: An wrapping the when a matching click arrives, or a timed-out result after the deadline.

WaitForSelectAsync(Message message, DiscordClient client, User user, string customId, Nullable<TimeSpan> timeout)

Waits for a select menu interaction on this message and returns the resulting interaction.

ParameterDescription
messageThe message whose select menus to listen on.
clientThe Discord client.
userThe user whose interaction to accept, or to accept any user.
customIdThe custom_id of the specific select menu to wait for, or to accept any select menu on the message.
timeoutThe maximum time to wait. Falls back to if not specified.

Returns: An wrapping the (with Data.Values containing the selected values) when a matching submission arrives, or a timed-out result after the deadline.
